plan.title: School Performance Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Key enrollment and infrastructure metrics across years

panels.title: Total Enrolment 2024
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Girls 2024" + "Boys 2024") AS total_enrolment FROM school_enrolment_by_year

panels.title: Girls vs Boys 2024
panels.sql: SELECT 'Girls' AS gender, SUM("Girls 2024") AS count FROM school_enrolment_by_year UNION ALL SELECT 'Boys', SUM("Boys 2024") FROM school_enrolment_by_year

panels.title: Enrollment Trend 2022-2024
panels.sql: SELECT '2022' AS year, SUM("Girls 2022" + "Boys 2022") AS total FROM school_enrolment_by_year UNION ALL SELECT '2023', SUM("Girls 2023" + "Boys 2023") FROM school_enrolment_by_year UNION ALL SELECT '2024', SUM("Girls 2024" + "Boys 2024") FROM school_enrolment_by_year ORDER BY year

panels.title: Infrastructure Availability
panels.sql: SELECT 'Toilets' AS item, SUM(CASE WHEN "Toilets functional (girls)"='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS available, SUM(CASE WHEN "Toilets functional (girls)"='No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing FROM school_infrastructure UNION ALL SELECT 'Water', SUM(CASE WHEN "Drinking water"='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN "Drinking water"='No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM school_infrastructure UNION ALL SELECT 'Electricity', SUM(CASE WHEN "Electricity"='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN "Electricity"='No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM school_infrastructure

plan.narrative: The dashboard highlights the overall enrollment growth, with a total of {{p1.total_enrolment}} students in 2024. Girls outnumber boys by {{p2.count}} students, indicating a gender balance trend. The enrollment line chart shows a steady rise from {{p3.total}} in 2022 to {{p3.total}} in 2024. Infrastructure gaps are evident: {{p4.available}} toilets, {{p4.missing}} missing, and similar disparities in water and electricity access.
